code_tools_setting_id.description: Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.

setting_binding_id.rationale: Binding IDs are naming elements only

product.description: Product type of the setting binding. Possible values are: `GEMINI_CODE_ASSIST`.
product.rationale: Product selection affects functional behaviour but not security posture directly.

labels.description: Labels as key value pairs. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration. Please refer to the field `effective_labels` for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: Labels are metadata only. Should avoid secrets

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource `name`. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: Location determines geographic residency of associated configurations.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
